caption: Castelluccio on the Piano Grande, Castelluccio di Norcia
composition: Tiny stone village on a green knoll in the vast Piano Grande with Sibillini peaks beyond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist looks across the vast green bowl of the Piano Grande to Castelluccio perched on its low knoll center-frame, the tiny cluster of stone houses dwarfed by the landscape. Rolling green ridges lead the eye to the snow-streaked Sibillini peaks rising behind under a clear blue sky. The 14:35 afternoon light is bright and crisp, and the plain stretches empty and enormous around the solitary village.
